overlayroot_cfgdisk.description: If this variable is set, it references a disk/filesystem that may exist, and include a 'overlayroot.conf' file in it's root directory. Default is 'disabled'.

overlayroot.description: The main overlayroot configuration setting. Supported values include 'tmpfs', 'device', 'crypt', or 'disabled'. Empty string disables overlayroot by default.
